import sys, numpy as np, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_traj import Session

s = Session('put_bottles_dustbin', instance='/app/instance.json')
env = s.env
from envs.utils import ArmTag
L, R = ArmTag('left'), ArmTag('right')

def run(pair, label):
    ok = env.move(pair)
    print(label, 'ok=',ok,'plan=',env.plan_success, flush=True)
    if not ok or not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError('planning/motion failed: '+label)

def safe_retreat_left(label):
    qhome=list(env.robot.left_original_pose[3:])
    home=list(env.robot.left_original_pose)
    run(env.move_by_displacement(L,z=0.25),label+' rise above table')
    run(env.move_to_pose(L,[home[0],home[1],1.08]+qhome),label+' traverse high')
    run(env.back_to_origin(L),label+' home')

def deliver_left(actor, label):
    # Bring a bottle to the open bin above its rim, then release into the bin.
    q = env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose()[3:]
    for name, xyz in [('bin_high',[-0.45,0.0,0.94]), ('bin_release',[-0.45,0.0,0.80])]:
        run(env.move_to_pose(L, xyz+list(q)), label+' '+name)
        print(label, name, 'tcp',env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose(),'bottle',actor.get_pose().p,flush=True)
    run(env.open_gripper(L),label+' open')
    env.delay(300)
    print(label,'settled bottle',actor.get_pose().p,flush=True)

def transfer_right_to_left(actor, label, left_grasp_q):
    print(label,'initial',actor.get_pose().p,flush=True)
    run(env.grasp_actor(actor,R,pre_grasp_dis=0.10,grasp_dis=0.0),label+' right grasp')
    run(env.move_by_displacement(R,z=0.14),label+' right lift')
    # Put the upright bottle at a point the left arm can reach. The right retains
    # its upper grasp; the left will take the lower body in the air.
    goal=np.array([0.03,0.178,0.95])
    bias=np.array([-0.091,0.091,-0.012])
    rel=actor.get_pose().p-np.asarray(env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose()[:3])
    qright=list(env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose()[3:])
    cmd=goal-rel-bias
    run(env.move_to_pose(R,cmd.tolist()+qright),label+' right to exchange')
    env.delay(300)
    for k in range(2):
        err=goal-actor.get_pose().p
        print(label,'station',k,'actor',actor.get_pose().p,'right tcp',env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose(),'error',err,flush=True)
        if np.linalg.norm(err)<0.045:
            break
        tcp=np.asarray(env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose()[:3])+err
        run(env.move_to_pose(R,tcp.tolist()+list(env.robot.get_right_tcp_pose()[3:])),label+f' station correction {k}')
        env.delay(250)
    ap=actor.get_pose().p.copy()
    # Use the bottle's marked grasp direction, shifted down from the end to its mid-body.
    left_pick=env.grasp_actor(actor,L,pre_grasp_dis=0.10,grasp_dis=0.0)
    receiver_shift=-0.055 if label=='bottle0' else -0.10
    for action in left_pick[1][:-1]:
        action.target_pose[:3]= (np.asarray(action.target_pose[:3])+np.array([0.0,0.0,receiver_shift])).tolist()
    print(label,'shifted receiver actions',[(a.action,a.target_pose) for a in left_pick[1]],flush=True)
    run((L,left_pick[1][:-1]),label+' left receive pose')
    env.delay(200)
    tcp=np.asarray(env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose()[:3])
    ap=actor.get_pose().p.copy()
    print(label,'left at receive',tcp,'bottle',ap,'delta',tcp-ap,flush=True)
    # Close the receiver as the giver opens, avoiding a two-gripper squeeze.
    before=ap.copy()
    ok=env.move(env.close_gripper(L),env.open_gripper(R))
    print(label,'simultaneous handoff',ok,'plan',env.plan_success,flush=True)
    if not ok or not env.plan_success:
        raise RuntimeError(label+' simultaneous handoff failed')
    env.delay(100)
    after=actor.get_pose().p.copy()
    print(label,'after handoff',after,flush=True)
    if abs(after[2]-before[2])>0.06:
        raise RuntimeError(label+' handoff dropped bottle')
    run(env.move_by_displacement(L,z=0.10),label+' left lift')
    env.delay(150)
    lifted=actor.get_pose().p.copy()
    print(label,'left lifted',lifted,'tcp',env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose(),flush=True)
    if lifted[2] < after[2]+0.04:
        raise RuntimeError(label+' left gripper did not retain bottle')
    deliver_left(actor,label)
    safe_retreat_left(label+' left retreat')
    run(env.back_to_origin(R),label+' right retreat')

s.record_start()
try:
    # Use the leftmost bottle to establish a reliable side-grasp orientation and drop motion.
    first=env.bottles[1]
    print('first initial',first.get_pose().p,flush=True)
    run(env.grasp_actor(first,L,pre_grasp_dis=0.10,grasp_dis=0.0),'first left grasp')
    left_grasp_q=list(env.robot.get_left_tcp_pose()[3:])
    print('left grasp orientation',left_grasp_q,'held',first.get_pose().p,flush=True)
    run(env.move_by_displacement(L,z=0.15),'first left lift')
    deliver_left(first,'first')
    safe_retreat_left('first left retreat')

    # Both bottles on the right half of the table transfer in the air at the same station.
    transfer_right_to_left(env.bottles[2],'bottle2',left_grasp_q)
    transfer_right_to_left(env.bottles[0],'bottle0',left_grasp_q)
except BaseException as exc:
    print('FAILED',repr(exc), 'plan_success',env.plan_success,flush=True)

a=s.record_stop()
print('FINAL',s.status(),'bottles',[b.get_pose().p.tolist() for b in env.bottles],'actions',a.shape,flush=True)
st=s.status()
if st['success']:
    replay=s.replay(a)
    print('REPLAY',replay,flush=True)
    if replay['success']:
        s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/trajectory.npz',meta={'source':'scripted frozen-instance trajectory','live_success':st,'replay':replay})
else:
    s.save_trajectory(a,'/app/output/probe.npz',meta={'stage':'candidate','status':st})
s.close()
